tier1.headline: Your data trains AI.
tier1.quote: IBM’s AI models and systems are designed, trained, validated, and tested on data from publicly available sources that may incidentally contain Personal Information.

tier1.headline: Your continued use is consent.
tier1.quote: By continuing to use our websites and services after a revision takes effect, it is considered that users have read and understand the changes.

tier1.headline: Your data is shared commercially.
tier1.quote: We may share personal information with third parties, such as advertising technology partners, data analytics providers and social networks engaged by IBM to deliver targeted IBM advertisements on their platforms, to aggregate information for analysis, and to track engagement with those advertisements.

tier1.headline: Your data is collected without account.
tier1.quote: If you visit our websites without logging in with an account , we may still collect information that is connected to your website visit.

tier2.headline: Your data is shared internally.
tier2.quote: Internally, personal information is shared for our business purposes: to improve efficiency, for cost savings, and internal collaboration between our subsidiaries (such as Red Hat).

tier2.headline: Your data is retained for defense.
tier2.quote: We retain any contractual relationship information for administrative purposes, legal and regulatory retention requirements, defending IBM rights, and to manage IBM's relationship with you.

tier2.headline: Your location is collected.
tier2.quote: Mobile application privacy notices may provide details about the information that is collected by the app, such as geo-location information or the unique User-ID of a device.

tier2.headline: Your behavior is profiled.
tier2.quote: We collect information about your use of our websites, such as: the webpages you view, the amount of time you spend on pages, the website URL that referred you to our pages, your geographic information derived from your IP address, and any hyperlinks you select.

tier2.headline: Your ads are personalized.
tier2.quote: Deliver targeted IBM advertisements on third-party websites based on information we or authorized third parties collect about your interactions with IBM websites, our content, emails, or, in select geographies, activity linked to your hashed email address.

tier2.headline: Your data transfers globally.
tier2.quote: Your personal information may be transferred to or accessed by IBM subsidiaries and third parties globally.

tier2.headline: Your data shared with government.
tier2.quote: In certain circumstances, personal information may be subject to disclosure to government agencies in accordance with judicial proceedings, court orders, or legal processes.

tier2.headline: Your deletion rights have limits.
tier2.quote: Your rights may be subject to limitations and exceptions resulting from applicable laws.
